games.name: Hatch A Pet 🐈
games.desc:
Formerly Idle Hatching!

Welcome! 🐾

How to play:
🥚 Buy an egg and insert to the machine to start hatching!
🐕 Collect the hatched animal and equip it on your plot!
💸 Animals generate money for you, even while you’re away!
✨ Buy powerful eggs and gears to hatch powerful animals!

Features:
🙌 Hatch eggs completely hands-free; Do anything while your eggs are hatching!
🕑 Hatching and money generation run even when you’re gone!
🧪 Stack multiple mutations on your animals. There are no limits!
🌴 Personalize your plot to various themes for different buffs!
✨ Use items to boost your production and luck!
🔮 Hatch the rarest supernatural creatures…

💻 Available on PC, Mobile and Console.
Made by developers from 🇲🇾, 🇻🇳, 🇵🇭, and 🇸🇬.

games.name: Dead Roads [UPDATE 1]
games.desc:
In 2019, the world succumbed to a vicious new virus. Known as "Nervo-19", this deadly virus attacks the central nervous system before taking control of the body. 

You and your friends must travel in an armored truck from the Vegas Outpost to the New York 5th Ave—Quarantine Zone where a potential vaccine awaits. The journey is long and dangerous but you must go for what little hope remains... Godspeed.

⭐Like and Favorite our game to stay up to date!

How to play: 
🚚 Drive your armored truck to the final outpost!
💰 Loot the buildings along the way!
🧟 Survive and run from "The Infected"!
🤝 Team up with your friends!

Inspired by: "Dead Rails", "The Last of Us", "The Walking Dead"
